title: Nine Grams of Soot
subtitle: 碳与化学元素 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 碳与化学元素（科学与技术·化学与材料）
meta: 主题语境：碳与化学元素（科学与技术·化学与材料）　|　核心词汇：carbon　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 carbon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 my mother was sent to weigh ① carbon she could not see, and she said the seeing was the whole of the lesson. The ② carbon, meaning the element and not the soot, was nine grams and was weighed by whoever came last; carbon, she said, is the only thing in a laboratory that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ carbon in that tray had the same mark, and the ④ carbon at the front, meaning the one the chemist kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever weighed properly. Carbon, my grandmother said, is nine parts dust and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the dust is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ carbon was the whole of the fuel, meaning the coal it came from and not the element. The ⑥ carbon, meaning the fuel and not any of that, is the only thing in a furnace that everybody burns and nobody questions; carbon, he said, is either something you weigh or the only word that means both an element and a fuel. She said the fuel is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ carbon had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the dust. The ⑧ carbon of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine grams and eleven years of weighing; carbon, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ carbon I remember is the one at the front, which was measured in 1984 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ gram of carbon, my grandmother said in 1989, is the only thing that improves by being measured; every carbon, she said, is a fuel that has agreed to look like an element. She said the fuel was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 碳（指那种元素本身，与烟灰相对）
C. 固定搭配：weigh carbon 称碳的重量
D. n. 碳（指盘里每一份）
E. n. 碳（指前面那一份）
F. n. 碳（抽象：它来自的那种燃料）
G. n. 那种燃料（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The carbon, meaning the element and not the soot
carbon was the whole of the fuel
the carbon had become a number in a report
The carbon of the whole thing
A gram of carbon, my grandmother said in 1989

answers.why: weigh carbon 意为“称碳的重量”，1964 年母亲被派去称一些她看不见的碳。
carbon 意为“碳”，指那种元素本身而不是烟灰，共九克，由最后走的人称量。
carbon 指盘里每一份碳，每一份都是同样的标记。
carbon 指前面那一份（化学家留的那一份），是唯一有人认真称过的。
carbon 意为“碳”，抽象指它来自的那种燃料，父亲说 carbon 就是那种燃料的全部。
carbon 为抽象用法，指那种燃料本身，是炉子里人人都烧、却没人质疑的东西。
carbon 意为“碳”，到 1979 年这份 carbon 成了报告里的一个数字。
carbon 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九克和十一年的称量。
carbon 意为“碳”，我记得的是前面那一份，1984 年测量，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
carbon 为抽象总称，祖母说一克碳是唯一会因为被认真测量而变好的东西。
